
══════════════════════════════════════════
  HUNT: Process Injection
══════════════════════════════════════════

  VERDICT     HIGH CONFIDENCE INJECTION
  Confidence  high
  Score       3/3
  Coverage    PARTIAL
  Review      high

  KEY SIGNALS

  [!] DETECTION  Live execution in a correlated allocation
      1 thread(s) currently execute inside an allocation that is simultaneously RWX and hosts a
      validated hidden PE — page type, structural PE validation, and live RIP/EIP all converge on
      the same AllocationBase.

  [~] LEAD       RWX memory
      1 memory region(s) carry PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE/WRITECOPY protection, spanning 1 distinct
      allocation(s).

  [~] LEAD       Hidden PE header
      1 address(es) contain a structurally-valid PE header (DOS+COFF+optional header+full section
      table all parsed successfully) at an address absent from the module list, in MEM_PRIVATE
      memory, an executable unbacked mapping, or otherwise correlated with an RWX allocation or live
      thread execution.

  [~] LEAD       Unbacked thread start
      1 thread(s) began execution at an address not covered by any known module.

  WHY THIS VERDICT

  Inference
    1 thread(s) currently execute inside an allocation that is simultaneously RWX and hosts a
    validated hidden PE — page type, structural PE validation, and live RIP/EIP all converge on the
    same AllocationBase.

  Confidence: HIGH
    This is the strongest evidence this hunter can produce: the process is, at the moment of the
    dump, actively running code from an allocation with no legitimate module backing and a concealed
    PE image.

  Caveat
    RIP is a single-point-in-time snapshot; a thread that executed there moments before or after the
    dump was captured would not appear here.

  COVERAGE

  [~] PARTIAL
      1 region(s) returned fewer bytes than requested while checking for hidden PE headers (short
      read) — not fully examined

  Use --verbose for complete per-region evidence and file offsets.
